require "test_helper"
require "yaml"
require "nokogiri"

class I18nTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test "en and ja locale files have complete key and interpolation parity" do
    en_all = load_flattened_locales("config/locales/**/*.en.yml", "en")
    ja_all = load_flattened_locales("config/locales/**/*.ja.yml", "ja")

    rails_en = flatten_hash(YAML.safe_load_file(Rails.root.join("config/locales/rails.en.yml"), permitted_classes: [ Symbol ])["en"])
    rails_ja = flatten_hash(YAML.safe_load_file(Rails.root.join("config/locales/rails.ja.yml"), permitted_classes: [ Symbol ])["ja"])

    # Every custom Rails key in rails.en.yml must exist in rails.ja.yml
    assert_empty rails_en.keys - rails_ja.keys, "Custom Rails keys missing in rails.ja.yml"

    app_en = en_all.except(*rails_en.keys)
    app_ja = ja_all.except(*rails_ja.keys)

    assert_empty app_en.keys - app_ja.keys, "Keys present in EN but missing in JA"
    assert_empty app_ja.keys - app_en.keys, "Keys present in JA but missing in EN"

    (app_en.keys & app_ja.keys).each do |key|
      en_vars = app_en[key].to_s.scan(/%\{(\w+)\}/).flatten.sort.uniq
      ja_vars = app_ja[key].to_s.scan(/%\{(\w+)\}/).flatten.sort.uniq
      assert_equal en_vars, ja_vars, "Interpolation variable mismatch for #{key}"
    end
  end

  test "static error pages render in both English and Japanese" do
    %w[ 400.html 404.html 406-unsupported-browser.html 422.html 500.html ].each do |filename|
      html = File.read(Rails.root.join("public", filename))
      doc = Nokogiri::HTML5(html)

      assert_match(/[A-Za-z]{3,}/, doc.text, "#{filename} should contain English text")
      assert_match(/\p{Hiragana}|\p{Katakana}|\p{Han}/, doc.text, "#{filename} should contain Japanese text")
      assert doc.at_css('[lang="ja"]'), "#{filename} should mark Japanese content with lang='ja'"
      assert_includes doc.at_css("a[href='/']").text, "Back home"
      assert_includes doc.at_css("a[href='/']").text, "ホームに戻る"
    end
  end

  test "identity locale validation and normalization" do
    identity = identities(:david)

    identity.locale = "  JA  "
    assert identity.valid?
    assert_equal "ja", identity.locale
    assert_equal :ja, identity.preferred_locale

    identity.locale = "en"
    assert identity.valid?
    assert_equal :en, identity.preferred_locale

    identity.locale = ""
    assert identity.valid?
    assert_nil identity.locale
    assert_equal :en, identity.preferred_locale

    identity.locale = "xx"
    assert_not identity.valid?
  end

  test "date and time formats in en and ja" do
    time = Time.utc(2026, 11, 19, 15, 5, 0)

    assert_equal "3pm on Thursday, November 19", I18n.l(time, format: :notification_bundle, locale: :en)
    assert_equal "11月19日(木) 15:05", I18n.l(time, format: :notification_bundle, locale: :ja)

    assert_equal "Nov 19, 2026", I18n.l(time, format: :stamp, locale: :en)
    assert_equal "2026年11月19日", I18n.l(time, format: :stamp, locale: :ja)

    assert_equal "Nov 19", I18n.l(time, format: :short_date, locale: :en)
    assert_equal "11月19日", I18n.l(time, format: :short_date, locale: :ja)
  end

  test "array choice sentence helper localizes connectors" do
    assert_equal "a or b", I18n.with_locale(:en) { %w[ a b ].to_choice_sentence }
    assert_equal "a, b, or c", I18n.with_locale(:en) { %w[ a b c ].to_choice_sentence }
    assert_equal "aまたはb", I18n.with_locale(:ja) { %w[ a b ].to_choice_sentence }
    assert_equal "a、b、またはc", I18n.with_locale(:ja) { %w[ a b c ].to_choice_sentence }
  end

  test "event descriptions, system comments, filters, time windows, colors, and push payloads localize to Japanese" do
    I18n.with_locale(:ja) do
      description = events(:logo_published).description_for(users(:david))
      assert_includes description.to_plain_text, "を追加しました"
      assert_includes description.to_html, "あなた"

      assert_equal "完了", Filter.indexed_by_human_name("closed")
      assert_equal "今はやらない", Filter.indexed_by_human_name("not_now")
      assert_equal "まもなく延期", Filter.indexed_by_human_name("postponing_soon")

      assert_equal "今日", TimeWindowParser.human_name_for("today")
      assert_equal "先週", TimeWindowParser.human_name_for("lastweek")

      assert_equal "ブルー", Color::COLORS.first.display_name

      card = cards(:text)
      Current.session = sessions(:david)
      assert_difference -> { card.comments.count }, 1 do
        card.close
      end
      assert_includes card.comments.last.body.to_plain_text, "完了"

      notification = notifications(:logo_published_kevin)
      payload = notification.payload
      assert_includes payload.body, "が追加"

      signup = Signup.new(email_address: "invalid")
      assert_not signup.valid?(:identity_creation)
      assert_match(/\p{Hiragana}|\p{Katakana}|\p{Han}/, signup.errors.full_messages.first)
    end
  end

  test "push notification uses recipient identity locale" do
    notification = notifications(:logo_published_kevin)
    notification.user.identity.update!(locale: "ja")

    captured_payload = nil
    fake_target = Object.new
    fake_target.define_singleton_method(:process) { |n| captured_payload = n.payload.to_h }

    original_targets = Notification.push_targets
    Notification.push_targets = [ fake_target ]
    begin
      I18n.with_locale(:en) do
        notification.push
      end
    ensure
      Notification.push_targets = original_targets
    end

    assert_not_nil captured_payload
    assert_includes captured_payload[:body], "が追加"
  end

  private
    def load_flattened_locales(glob, root_key)
      Dir.glob(Rails.root.join(glob)).sort.each_with_object({}) do |file, out|
        data = YAML.safe_load_file(file, permitted_classes: [ Symbol ])
        out.merge!(flatten_hash(data[root_key]))
      end
    end

    def flatten_hash(hash, prefix = nil)
      hash.each_with_object({}) do |(k, v), out|
        key = prefix ? "#{prefix}.#{k}" : k.to_s
        if v.is_a?(Hash)
          out.merge!(flatten_hash(v, key))
        else
          out[key] = v
        end
      end
    end
end

class LocaleSwitchingTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  test "people who never chose a locale keep rendering exact English even with Accept-Language header" do
    sign_in_as :david

    get root_path, headers: { "Accept-Language" => "ja,en;q=0.5" }
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "html[lang='en']"
    assert_select "a.header__skip-navigation", "Skip to main content"
    assert_select "span", "Add a card"
    assert_equal "en-US", JSON.parse(css_select("meta[name='i18n']").first["content"])["intl_locale"]
  end

  test "opening any authenticated page with ?locale=ja switches to Japanese and persists across session and clean browser sign-in" do
    sign_in_as :david

    get root_path(locale: "ja")
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "html[lang='ja']"
    assert_select "a.header__skip-navigation", "メインコンテンツへスキップ"
    assert_select "span", "カードを追加"
    assert_equal "ja-JP", JSON.parse(css_select("meta[name='i18n']").first["content"])["intl_locale"]
    assert_equal "ja", identities(:david).reload.locale

    # Sticks for the rest of the session without ?locale=ja
    get board_path(boards(:writebook))
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "html[lang='ja']"
    assert_select "h2.cards__expander-title", text: /検討中？/
    assert_select "h2.cards__expander-title", text: /今はやらない/
    assert_select "h2.cards__expander-title", text: /完了/

    # Sticks again the next time they sign in from a completely clean browser
    reset!
    integration_session.default_url_options[:script_name] = "/#{ActiveRecord::FixtureSet.identify("37signals")}"
    sign_in_as :david

    get root_path
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "html[lang='ja']"
    assert_select "a.header__skip-navigation", "メインコンテンツへスキップ"
  end

  test "opening root path without account slug with ?locale=ja persists choice across redirect" do
    sign_in_as :david

    untenanted do
      get "/?locale=ja"
      assert_response :redirect
      follow_redirect!
    end

    assert_equal "ja", identities(:david).reload.locale
  end

  test "unauthenticated ?locale=ja sticks across session and persists onto identity upon sign-in" do
    untenanted do
      get new_session_path(locale: "ja")
      assert_response :success
      assert_select "html[lang='ja']"
      assert_select "h1", "Fizzyにサインイン"

      # Sticks on next unauthenticated page without query param
      get new_signup_path
      assert_response :success
      assert_select "html[lang='ja']"
      assert_select "h1", "新規登録"

      # Sign in after choosing Japanese while signed out: magic link email is also in Japanese
      identity = identities(:kevin)
      assert_nil identity.locale

      perform_enqueued_jobs do
        post session_path, params: { email_address: identity.email_address }
      end
      magic_link_email = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last
      assert_includes magic_link_email.subject, "Fizzy確認コード:"

      get session_magic_link_path
      assert_response :success
      assert_select "html[lang='ja']"
      assert_select "h1", "メールを確認してください"

      magic_link = identity.magic_links.order(id: :desc).first
      post session_magic_link_path, params: { code: magic_link.code }
      assert_response :redirect
    end

    assert_equal "ja", identities(:kevin).reload.locale

    # Clean browser sign-in remembers Japanese
    reset!
    integration_session.default_url_options[:script_name] = "/#{ActiveRecord::FixtureSet.identify("37signals")}"
    sign_in_as :kevin
    get root_path
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "html[lang='ja']"
  end

  test "signing in from a clean browser as a Japanese user sends magic link email in Japanese" do
    identities(:david).update!(locale: "ja")

    untenanted do
      perform_enqueued_jobs do
        post session_path, params: { email_address: identities(:david).email_address }
      end
    end

    email = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last
    assert_includes email.subject, "Fizzy確認コード:"
    assert_includes email.html_part.body.decoded, "Fizzy確認コード"
  end

  test "signing out does not leak locale to a different user on the same browser" do
    sign_in_as :david
    get root_path(locale: "ja")
    assert_select "html[lang='ja']"

    sign_out
    sign_in_as :kevin

    get root_path
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "html[lang='en']"
  end

  test "switching back to English with ?locale=en persists" do
    identities(:david).update!(locale: "ja")
    sign_in_as :david

    get root_path
    assert_select "html[lang='ja']"

    get root_path(locale: "en")
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "html[lang='en']"
    assert_equal "en", identities(:david).reload.locale

    get root_path
    assert_select "html[lang='en']"
  end

  test "unsupported locale never breaks a page and does not switch anything" do
    # Default English stays English
    sign_in_as :david
    get root_path(locale: "xx")
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "html[lang='en']"
    assert_nil identities(:david).reload.locale

    # Japanese stays Japanese
    get root_path(locale: "ja")
    assert_select "html[lang='ja']"

    get root_path(locale: "xx")
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "html[lang='ja']"
    assert_equal "ja", identities(:david).reload.locale

    # Malformed non-string locale param does not break
    get "#{root_path}?locale[]=ja"
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "html[lang='ja']"

    # Unauthenticated unsupported locale
    sign_out
    untenanted do
      get new_session_path(locale: "xx")
      assert_response :success
      assert_select "html[lang='en']"
    end
  end

  test "public board and card switch to Japanese with ?locale=ja" do
    board = boards(:writebook)
    board.publish unless board.published?
    card = board.cards.published.first

    get public_board_path(board.publication.key, locale: "ja")
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "html[lang='ja']"
    assert_select "h2.cards__expander-title", text: /検討中？/

    # Sticks on subsequent public card page without ?locale=ja
    get public_card_path(board.publication.key, card)
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "html[lang='ja']"
    assert_includes response.body, "に戻る"
  end

  test "bearer token authentication honors identity locale and ?locale=ja" do
    token = identities(:david).access_tokens.create!(description: "Locale test", permission: :write)

    get boards_path(format: :json, locale: "ja"), headers: { "Authorization" => "Bearer #{token.token}" }
    assert_response :success
    assert_equal "ja", identities(:david).reload.locale
  end

  test "PWA manifest renders in the user's locale" do
    sign_in_as :david

    get pwa_manifest_path(format: :json)
    assert_response :success
    assert_equal "Card-up the biggest issues in your projects", response.parsed_body["description"]

    identities(:david).update!(locale: "ja")
    get pwa_manifest_path(format: :json)
    assert_response :success
    assert_equal "プロジェクトの重要な課題をカードで管理", response.parsed_body["description"]
    assert_equal "通知", response.parsed_body["shortcuts"].first["name"]
  end

  test "fragment caching isolates English and Japanese pages" do
    with_caching do
      sign_in_as :david
      get card_path(cards(:logo))
      assert_response :success
      assert_select "html[lang='en']"
      assert_includes response.body, "Subscribers"

      get card_path(cards(:logo), locale: "ja")
      assert_response :success
      assert_select "html[lang='ja']"
      assert_includes response.body, "通知を受け取るメンバー"
      assert_not_includes response.body, "Subscribers"
    end
  end

  test "all major authenticated screens render cleanly in Japanese without missing translations" do
    identities(:kevin).update!(locale: "ja")
    sign_in_as :kevin

    board = boards(:writebook)
    card = cards(:logo)
    user = users(:kevin)
    webhook = webhooks(:active)

    [
      root_path,
      new_board_path,
      board_path(board),
      edit_board_path(board),
      board_columns_closed_path(board),
      board_columns_not_now_path(board),
      board_columns_stream_path(board),
      cards_path,
      card_path(card),
      edit_card_path(card),
      new_card_assignment_path(card),
      edit_card_board_path(card),
      edit_card_column_path(card),
      new_card_tagging_path(card),
      account_settings_path,
      account_join_code_path,
      edit_account_join_code_path,
      my_menu_path,
      my_access_tokens_path,
      new_my_access_token_path,
      my_passkeys_path,
      my_pins_path,
      notifications_path,
      notifications_settings_path,
      search_path,
      user_path(user),
      edit_user_path(user),
      new_user_email_address_path(user),
      user_events_path(user),
      board_webhooks_path(board),
      new_board_webhook_path(board),
      board_webhook_path(board, webhook),
      edit_board_webhook_path(board, webhook)
    ].each do |path|
      get path
      assert_response :success, "Expected 200 for #{path}"
      if response.body.include?("<html")
        assert_select "html[lang='ja']", true, "Expected lang='ja' on #{path}"
      end
      assert_not_includes response.body, "translation missing", "Missing translation on #{path}"
    end
  end

  private
    def with_caching
      original_store = Rails.cache
      original_perform_caching = ActionController::Base.perform_caching
      ActionController::Base.perform_caching = true
      ActionController::Base.cache_store = ActiveSupport::Cache::MemoryStore.new
      yield
    ensure
      ActionController::Base.perform_caching = original_perform_caching
      ActionController::Base.cache_store = original_store
    end
end
